note: Both sets repeat the same four misbound claims (dryer model DV17540NBL00 credited to PRATT & LAMBERT, tag P3 given type TEMPERED, SHOWER SURROUND given colour number 33-14, and KITCHEN given colour name STEEL WOOL), so their error counts are equal. Set A additionally extracts 13 claims that all check out against the schedules (e.g. DRYER manufacturer BLOMBERG, ACCENT PAINT colour number 33-14, WALL BASE profile, and correctly tagged quantities for F3 SOFA, F4, F5, F6, F2 BEDSIDE TABLE, MWK02, MWK04, MWK05, MWB01, MWK03). Set B's shown claims are entirely contained in Set A's and add nothing, so it omits a large amount of correct equipment, finish, furniture and millwork data. Both share the same vague entities (bare tag F2, bare field label FINISH) and the unsupported 'KITCHEN' location on the quartz rows.
remarks: The text layer is column-scrambled, which produced cross-row joins: 'LOCATION: KITCHEN COLOUR NAME: STEEL WOOL' and 'LOCATION: SHOWER SURROUND COLOUR NUMBER: 33-14' splice the GL/P3 rows together, and the P3 tag label lands next to the GLASS row's TYPE: TEMPERED. The QUARTZ rows carry no LOCATION field, so the added condition 'location: KITCHEN' is not supported by the page. Both extractions also miss straightforward facts such as GLASS thickness 1/2" (shower surround) and TELEVISION size 40" (model TBD).
